review.head: ce73ae9efb7f17d6dc278e92d836743f688a87d8
checks: I read the FileBrowser branch of render_modal in src/tui/ui.rs. The bordered inner area is computed with block.inner(). Zero-size areas return early, and the code never indexes or subtracts from an empty area.

header_height = min(inner.height - 1, 3), so the header never takes the last inner row. Whenever inner.height >= 1, list_area has at least one row. list_area.height is inner.height minus header_height, so it cannot underflow.

start = selected_idx + 1 - visible_count (saturating) and end = min(start + visible_count, len). For selected_idx < len this always includes the selected row. The old max(5) minimum and the wrapped-header overflow are gone. Headers and items are one line each, as Paragraph without wrap and List both clip by cell width.

Narrow widths: the icon and indent are dropped first, then the cursor below 4 columns. Control characters in the directory path and file names are replaced with spaces for display only. entries, selected_idx and the paths stay untouched, and the render path takes &TuiApp.

I did not run the tests, as instructed. From reading them, archived_80x12_selected_idx_4_remains_visible matches the archived case (12 entries, idx 4, 80x12). The selected row is identified by yellow plus bold, so it would fail on the old renderer, where item_04 is pushed below the visible area. Other tests cover Down/Up/j/k, shrink and grow, long and Unicode names, 0..8 x 0..6 tiny sizes, directory navigation, and full-path preservation for all four targets after Enter.

The diff touches only ui.rs, tests/tui_viewport.rs and interfaces.md, all within allowed_paths. Nothing in it touches crypto, keystore or file-operation code. Key handling in app.rs is unchanged, and the confirm-path test asserts the same path fields and flags as before.

interfaces.md describes the new behavior: headers yield to the entry row, no five-row assumption, clipping by terminal width, and the tiny-size guarantee limited to safe rendering. The statement is consistent with the code.

Limitations: I read the files only and did not independently run the gate, tests or a PTY. I rely on the coordinator for those results. Some wide-glyph clipping at 1-3 columns could not be checked by reading alone. No backend model attestation is given.
